title: Law to create a trade-in program for powerful e-bikes
summary: This bill would require the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection to run a program letting people trade in Class 3 e-bikes or similar overpowered devices for a Class 1 or Class 2 e-bike or a voucher usable at an e-bike retailer. The agency would hold at least one trade-in event per community district each year, set trade-in values, and could not limit eligibility by occupation or income. The law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
